caption: Girl dinner, going down right now:
title: Girl dinner, going down right now 🫥

through_line.name: the cheese stick
through_line.prop_prompt: a single cylindrical stick of string cheese, half peeled out of its plastic wrapper, pale yellow and slightly bent, with four small dark olives beside it
progression: one small pale shape descending alone
the cheese stick coming down, very slowly, very alone
the cheese stick lands and introduces itself
four olives arrive and the floor is still mostly empty
nothing new arrives, the room stays bare
a very large block of cheese fills the whole opening

blocks.through_line_state: one small pale shape descending alone
blocks.sfx: a plastic wrapper crinkle, a faint echo, a swallow
shots: MEDIUM, eye level: Pipes peering upward into a very quiet tube
CLOSE, low angle: Gut perking up, eyes bright for once
MEDIUM, high angle: one small pale shape drifting down alone
CLOSE on the eyes: Gut waiting for the rest, which does not come

turns.speaker: pipes
turns.line: Okay. Something's finally coming down.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Good. What are we getting?

turns.speaker: pipes
turns.line: One cheese stick. And four olives.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: That's dinner? That's the entire dinner?

blocks.through_line_state: the cheese stick coming down, very slowly, very alone
blocks.sfx: a slow scrape, a hollow echo, a creak
shots: CLOSE, low angle: Gut yelling upward, tube echoing back
MEDIUM, eye level: Pipes holding the small shape apologetically
MEDIUM, high angle: the empty tube stretching away above
CLOSE on Pipes' eyes avoiding contact

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Send it back and get real food.

turns.speaker: pipes
turns.line: There is no real food coming.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: She stood at the counter an hour.

turns.speaker: pipes
turns.line: Then she sat down. That's it.

blocks.through_line_state: the cheese stick lands and introduces itself
blocks.sfx: a small plop, a soft echo, a cheerful chirp
shots: MEDIUM, high angle: the cheese stick landing in an enormous empty cavity
CLOSE, low angle: two small friendly eyes opening on it
MEDIUM, eye level: Gut looking around at all the empty space
CLOSE on the eyes: Gut and the cheese stick, alone together

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Where's the rest of you?

turns.speaker: cheese_stick
turns.line: Hi! It's just me tonight!

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: You're a stick of cheese.

turns.speaker: cheese_stick
turns.line: And four olives! They're right behind me!

blocks.through_line_state: four olives arrive and the floor is still mostly empty
blocks.sfx: a monitor blip, a distant TV murmur, a sigh
shots: MEDIUM, eye level: HQ watching a show on the hanging monitor
CLOSE, low angle: the screen glow across HQ's face
MEDIUM, high angle: HQ not turning around
CLOSE on HQ's eyes fixed on the screen

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: HQ. This is not sustainable.

turns.speaker: hq
turns.line: She said she wasn't hungry.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: She is always hungry. I'd know.

turns.speaker: hq
turns.line: She's watching a show. Give it time.

blocks.through_line_state: nothing new arrives, the room stays bare
blocks.sfx: a hopeful rummage, a hollow scrape, a disappointed pop
shots: MEDIUM, high angle: Loops surging up eagerly and finding nothing
CLOSE, low angle: Loops' three pairs of eyes searching
MEDIUM, eye level: Gut gesturing at the empty floor
CLOSE on the eyes: Loops undeterred, Gut defeated

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Loops, is anything reaching you?

turns.speaker: loops
turns.line: Ooh! Is that cheese? Send it down!

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: That's everything, Loops. All of it.

turns.speaker: loops
turns.line: I can work with this! Barely!

blocks.through_line_state: a very large block of cheese fills the whole opening
blocks.sfx: a fridge door suction, a heavy thud, silence
shots: MEDIUM, eye level: the tunnel quiet, then a distant fridge light spilling in
CLOSE, low angle: Gut looking up sharply
MEDIUM, high angle: an enormous block shape filling the opening above
CLOSE on the eyes: Rusty entirely unsurprised

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: It's eleven. She's standing at the fridge.

turns.speaker: rusty
turns.line: Here we go.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: She's got the whole block of cheese.

turns.speaker: rusty
turns.line: This is the real dinner.
